title: Siemens SM0901 CRT no display / black screen: warning alert
body_devto:
## Important Note

CRITICAL: Siemens SINUMERIK displays run on AC 110V. Connecting a standard DC 24V LCD module will destroy it instantly. Verify your replacement explicitly supports AC input.

## A Siemens SM0901 CRT showing no display / black screen is one of the most common service calls in CNC maintenance. Here's what's actually happening inside that display and what to do about it.

## Technical Details

When replacing a Siemens SM0901 CRT, check three things: (1) connector type — DB-25 (25-pin D-Sub), (2) power supply — AC 110V, (3) control system — SINUMERIK 810, SINUMERIK 820, SINUMERIK 840D. All three are covered by the standard LCD upgrade. Price: $299.

A blank CRT often means the flyback transformer (high-voltage section) has failed completely. This component steps up power to 20-30kV — when it goes, there's no image at all.

## Summary

An LCD module eliminates the Siemens CRT failure cycle permanently. Full Siemens upgrade guide and compatibility info: https://cncdisplay.com/brands/Siemens.html
